Initial release of the AANA Release Readiness Check Skill.

- Provides detailed pre-release readiness guidelines for OpenClaw-style agents.
- Defines required checks for artifacts, tests, documentation, security, and approval.
- Outlines evidence and artifact/version consistency rules.

- Details decision rules and a structured release gate output pattern.
